arguments.text: Implemented evaluate(request,evidence,policy) with caller-supplied inputs: missing required request keys return sorted unknowns; eligibility requires matching claim, non-withdrawn record, exact canonical JSON match on every required condition, and verified=true when required; only eligible records can supersede sources; empty eligibility returns no-matching-evidence unknown; canonical value disagreement returns conflict without source-count voting; agreement returns supported except Boolean false returns unsupported. Inputs remain unchanged. Current report is supported vertical_rate=30 from S1 and unsupported device_validated=false from D1. Boundary checks covered missing conditions, verification, conflicts, nested canonical JSON, supersession, withdrawn/ineligible superseders, null values, absent calibration, exact output keys, and input immutability.
